business_problem: The IBM CIO Organization needed to reduce manual effort in repetitive infrastructure tasks and expand who could author Ansible automation without slowing modernization of business-critical internal systems.
solution_summary: The IBM CIO Organization used the technical preview of IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Red Hat Ansible Lightspeed alongside Red Hat Ansible Automation to speed repetitive IT work across IBM's internal estate. The Hybrid Cloud Platforms team already relied on Ansible for patching, vulnerability remediation, and health checks, and the pilot inserted generative AI at the authoring layer: developers describe a task in natural language and watsonx Code Assistant produces recommended playbook content. That content still fits into established Ansible-based workflows, so AI augments rather than replaces operational controls. In the pilot, the tool produced 60% of initial playbook content, demonstrating a path from a specialist group of roughly 10 playbook authors to a much broader contributor pool. The resulting architecture couples natural-language generation with production automation to accelerate modernization without abandoning proven platform standards.
